newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Nafin interest rate for May 24.88 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Nafin interest rate for May 24.88 pct.

text.p: Mexico's state development bank Nacional Financiera (Nafin) on Friday said its so-called "Tasa Nafin" interest rate for May was set at 24.88 percent.
The rate fell from April's rate of 26.79 percent.

Nafin recently changed its interest rate policy, setting the Interbank Equilibrium Interest Rate (TIIE) as the base rate for new loans to businesses, but it said it would continue to publish the Tasa Nafin for loans that were originally drawn up using it as the base rate.
Debtors whose credits are eligible for the Nafin rate can opt either to use it or the TIIE, but they cannot change their decision once it is made, Nafin has said.

Nafin said it would charge loans to microbusinesses at the TIIE, to small businesses at TIIE plus 100 basis points, to medium-sized companies at TIIE plus 200 bps, and to large firms at TIIE plus 300 bps.
